lines: Penetration into consciousness, presence with unity, dismissal, movement toward essential nature, destruction of doubts, splendor of rising of cakras thus, purpose in order.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bodhāveśaḥ sannidhiraikyena visarjanaṃ svarūpagatiḥ śaṅkādalanaṃ cakrodayadīptiriti kramātkṛtyam
